claims.claim: The bike is just 3 month old and in good conditions.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a used scooter/motorbike with visible dirt/scuffing; no readable proof of age, mileage, or condition beyond general appearance.

risks.risk: Engine/motor may not start or may have internal issues (compression, overheating, worn parts). Photos cannot confirm running condition.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the engine starting from cold, idling steadily, and a brief throttle test (no unusual knocking/smoke).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working (worst-case: needs inspection/repair).

risks.risk: Brake performance may be weak or unsafe (pads/lines/discs/drums, air in system, leaks). Photos cannot confirm braking.
risks.proof: A clip showing front and rear brake test at low speed with clear stopping and no brake fluid leakage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes unverified (worst-case: servicing/replacement may be needed).

risks.risk: Tyres may be worn, cracked, or punctured; tread depth and sidewall condition are not shown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tyres (tread depth, sidewall cracks) plus a quick spin test showing no wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres condition unknown (worst-case: tyre replacement).

risks.risk: Electricals may be faulty (headlight beam, indicators, horn, brake light). Photos only show headlight presence, not function.
risks.proof: A video showing headlight on (high/low if applicable), both indicators flashing, horn, and brake light working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as electricals unverified (worst-case: wiring/bulb/relay issues).

risks.risk: Chassis/frame may have hidden damage from an accident (bends/cracks) not visible in the single angle.
risks.proof: Walk-around video showing both sides, undercarriage clearance, and any frame welds/cracks; include a straight-line alignment check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as structural condition unknown (worst-case: frame repair/replacement risk).

risks.risk: Documents/registration status may be problematic; plate is not clearly readable and ownership cannot be verified from photos.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the full plate number and any registration/ownership documents (receipt, registration card), matching the plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as documentation unverified (worst-case: buyer may face legal/transfer issues).

risks.risk: Mileage/odometer may be high or tampered; age claim cannot be validated without odometer reading.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the odometer/mileage reading and a timestamped start-up video showing it remains consistent.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mileage unknown (worst-case: higher wear).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the odometer/mileage reading.
Send a short video of the scooter starting from cold, idling, and a brief throttle test (no abnormal smoke/knocking).
Send close-up photos of tyres (tread + sidewalls) and brakes (front/rear).
Send a video showing all electricals: headlight (high/low), indicators, horn, and brake light.
Send a walk-around video showing both sides and any frame/weld areas for cracks/bends.
Send clear photos of the full license plate number and any registration/ownership documents for transfer.
response.reason: The witness can only confirm it is a used-looking motorbike/scooter; key factors that determine price in Abuja (working status, brakes, tyres, electricals, mileage, and documents) are not verifiable from the provided report. Without those proof points, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
